Air.desc: You can manipulate lightning, mist, and wind, traffic with air creatures, and are resistant to electricity damage.

Animal.desc: You can speak with and befriend animals with ease. In addition, you treat Knowledge (nature) as a class skill.

Artifice.desc: You can repair damage to objects, animate objects with life, and create objects from nothing.

Chaos.desc: Your touch infuses life and weapons with chaos, and you revel in all things anarchic.

Charm.desc: You can baffle and befuddle foes with a touch or a smile, and your beauty and grace are divine.

Community.desc: Your touch can heal wounds, and your presence instills unity and strengthens emotional bonds.

Death.desc: You can cause the living to bleed at a touch, and find comfort in the presence of the dead.

Destruction.desc: You revel in ruin and devastation, and can deliver particularly destructive attacks.

Earth.desc: You have mastery over earth, metal, and stone, can fire darts of acid, and command earth creatures.

Evil.desc: You are sinister and cruel, and have wholly pledged your soul to the cause of evil.

Fire.desc: You can call forth fire, command creatures of the inferno, and your flesh does not burn.

Glory.desc: You are infused with the glory of the divine, and are a true foe of the undead. In addition, when you channel positive energy to harm undead creatures, the save DC to halve the damage is increased by 2.

Good.desc: You have pledged your life and soul to goodness and purity.

Healing.desc: Your touch staves off pain and death, and your healing magic is particularly vital and potent.

Knowledge.desc: You are a scholar and a sage of legends. In addition, you treat all Knowledge skills as class skills.

Law.desc: You follow a strict and ordered code of laws, and in so doing, achieve enlightenment.

Liberation.desc: You are a spirit of freedom and a staunch foe against all who would enslave and oppress.

Luck.desc: You are infused with luck, and your mere presence can spread good fortune.

Madness.desc: You embrace the madness that lurks deep in your heart, and can unleash it to drive your foes insane or to sacrifice certain abilities to hone others.

Magic.desc: You are a true student of all things mystical, and see divinity in the purity of magic.

Nobility.desc: You are a great leader, an inspiration to all who follow the teachings of your faith.

Plant.desc: You find solace in the green, can grow defensive thorns, and can communicate with plants.

Protection.desc: Your faith is your greatest source of protection, and you can use that faith to defend others. In addition, you receive a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws. This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 levels you possess.

Repose.desc: You see death not as something to be feared, but as a final rest and reward for a life well spent. The taint of undeath is a mockery of what you hold dear.

Rune.desc: In strange and eldritch runes you find potent magic. You gain Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

Strength.desc: In strength and brawn there is truth—your faith gives you incredible might and power.

Sun.desc: You see truth in the pure and burning light of the sun, and can call upon its blessing or wrath to work great deeds.

Travel.desc: You are an explorer and find enlightenment in the simple joy of travel, be it by foot or conveyance or magic. Increase your base speed by 10 feet.

Trickery.desc: You are a master of illusions and deceptions. Bluff, Disguise, and Stealth are class skills.

War.desc: You are a crusader for your god, always ready and willing to fight to defend your faith.

Water.desc: You can manipulate water and mist and ice, conjure creatures of water, and resist cold.

Weather.desc: With power over storm and sky, you can call down the wrath of the gods upon the world below.

Aquatic.desc: You master the deeps of the sea, raging rivers, flowing falls, and relentless tides.

Arctic.desc: You master the might of the endless, snow-covered wastes beneath the midnight sun, where icy polar winds blow.

spells.name: Statue
spells.note: looking like a stalagmite or stalactite

Cave.desc: The wonders and dark secrets of the deepest caves give you strength.

spells.name: Transmute Rock To Mud
spells.note: creates loose sand instead of mud

Desert.desc: The spirits and secrets of the endless wastes are yours to command.

Eagle.desc: Your spirit soars with the mightiest and noblest of all winged creatures.

Frog.desc: You venerate the elder amphibians that first brought life to land.

Jungle.desc: The spirits of the jungle, both of natural guardians and lost civilizations, whisper in your heart.

Monkey.desc: The balanced wisdom, skill, agility, and playfulness of the monkey are the model for your spiritual discipline.

Mountain.desc: You have mastered the mighty powers of the great mountains that pierce the sky and stand aloof above the lowlands.

Plains.desc: The wide open spaces of the prairie, savanna, and steppe are yours to master.

Serpent.desc: You serve ancient serpentine mysteries whose coils still encircle the world.

Swamp.desc: The sour-sweet depths of bogs, marshes, and swamps are your places of power.

Wolf.desc: You run with the pack and are the master of the cold hunt of your spirit totem.

Aberrant.desc: There is a taint in your blood, one that is alien and bizarre. You tend to think in odd ways, approaching problems from an angle that most would not expect. Over time, this taint manifests itself in your physical form.

Abyssal.desc: Generations ago, a demon spread its filth into your heritage. While it does not manifest in all of your kin, for you it is particularly strong. You might sometimes have urges to chaos or evil, but your destiny (and align

Aquatic.desc: Your family traces its heritage back to the ocean depths, whether scions of undersea empires left in the wake of nomadic sea-tribes, or the spawn of creeping ichthyic infiltrators into remote seaside villages. The song o

Arcane.desc: Your family has always been skilled in the eldritch art of magic. While many of your relatives were accomplished wizards, your powers developed without the need for study and practice.

Boreal.desc: Descended from inhabitants of the lands of ice and snow, you count among your ancestors giant-kin, troll-born, and frost-rimed spirits. Their savage and raw energies flow down through generations to infuse you to the mar

Celestial.desc: Your bloodline is blessed by a celestial power, either from a celestial ancestor or through divine intervention. Although this power drives you along the path of good, your fate (and alignment) is your own to determine.

Deep Earth.desc: The echoing cave-songs and the rumble and creak of primal spirits deep below the ground thrum in your soul and in all your family line. You are likely slow, steady, and stable in your thinking, little prone to wandering

Destined.desc: Your family is destined for greatness in some way. Your birth could have been foretold in prophecy, or perhaps it occurred during an especially auspicious event, such as a solar eclipse. Regardless of your bloodline's or

Draconic.desc: At some point in your family's history, a dragon interbred with your bloodline, and now its ancient power flows through your veins.

Dreamspun.desc: Your family is a long line of dreamers, who dream not as ordinary mortals do but rather as those who reach through and touch the supernal realm of dreams and the farthest shores of night. Whether it is a gift or curse is

Elemental.desc: The power of the elements resides in you, and at times you can hardly control its fury. This influence comes from an elemental outsider in your family history or a time when you or your relatives were exposed to a powerf

Fey.desc: The capricious nature of the fey runs in your family due to some intermingling of fey blood or magic. You are more emotional than most, prone to bouts of joy and rage.

spells.note: devils and creatures with the fiendish template only

Infernal.desc: Somewhere in your family's history, a relative made a deal with a devil, and that pact has influenced your family line ever since. In you, it manifests in direct and obvious ways, granting you powers and abilities. While

Protean.desc: You have in your veins the ever-changing wildness of primal chaos, the raw essence of unbound creation. Your mind and spirit burst with the constant inspiration of consummate freedom, though you have difficulty following

Serpentine.desc: Your bloodline carries the lingering stain of ancient serpent races that ruled when the world was young; your forebears were likely favored slaves anointed by their reptilian masters and gifted with their cold cunning an

Shadow.desc: Spirits from the shadow plane dally at times in the world of light, and such as these lay with your ancestors once upon a time, imparting the mystery of shadow-stuff into your lineage. You are often sullen and withdrawn,

spells.name: Call Lightning Storm
spells.note: dealing fire damage, damage increased outdoors at night

Starsoul.desc: You come from a line of stargazers and explorers who delved deeply into the darkness beyond the stars. In touching the void, the void touched them, and your mind, spirit, and body yearn to span the gulf between worlds.

Stormborn.desc: You trace your heritage to fierce and proud spirits of storm and sky, and living lightning sings in your veins.

Undead.desc: The taint of the grave runs through your family. Perhaps one of your ancestors became a powerful lich or vampire, or maybe you were born dead before suddenly returning to life. Either way, the forces of death move throug

Verdant.desc: Your progenitors infused themselves with raw plant life, binding it into their own tissue and passing it down to their literal seed, giving you innate communion with nature.

Aberrant.desc: There is a taint in your blood that is both alien and bizarre. When you bloodrage, this manifests in peculiar and terrifying ways.

Abyssal.desc: Generations ago, a demon spread its filth into the essence of your bloodline. While it doesn't manifest in all of your kin, in those moments when you're bloodraging, you embody its terrifying presence.

Arcane.desc: While others of your kin may be powerful wizards and sorcerers, the eldritch nature of the blood coursing through your veins transforms you into a spell-breaking terror.

Celestial.desc: By way of a celestial ancestor or divine intervention, the blood of angels fills your body with a holy potency, granting you a majestic visage and angelic powers when you enter your bloodrage.

Destined.desc: Your bloodline is destined for great things. When you bloodrage, you exude a greatness that makes all but the most legendary creatures seem lesser.

Draconic.desc: At some point in your family's history, a dragon interbred with your bloodline. Now, the sublime monster's ancient power fuels your bloodrage.

Elemental.desc: The power of the elements resides in you, and at times you can hardly control its fury. This influence comes either from an elemental outsider in your family history or from a moment when you or your ancestors were expos

Fey.desc: One of your ancestors was fey, or the fey realm somehow intermixed with your bloodline. It affects your bloodrage in tricky and surprising ways.

Infernal.desc: The Pit lives in your blood. Maybe one of your ancestors was seduced by the powers of Hell or made a deal with a devil. Either way, its corruption seethes within your lineage.

Undead.desc: The foul corruption of undeath is a part of you. Somewhere in the past, death became infused with your lineage. Your connection to the attributes of the undead bestows frightening power when your bloodrage.
